data.description:
## Context / Problem
Running the documented local preview command with `REBAR_VERIFY_ENABLE_CODE_REVIEW=1` fails before review because project criterion `project.review-phase-boundaries` requires `.rebar/prompts/code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries.md`, but the runtime reports that prompt id as unknown. This was observed from current `origin/main` while preparing Gerrit change 990.

## Approach
Trace project prompt discovery/registration for code-review criteria and align the project criterion reference with the prompt id loaded by the runtime. Rejected: bypassing the project criterion, because that would silently reduce review coverage.

## Scope
- `.rebar/prompts/code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries.md` and the code-review prompt discovery/registry path identified during diagnosis.

## Testing
- Reproduce the current failure with the documented `rebar review-code --base origin/main --head HEAD -o text` preview.
- Verify the same command reaches review with project criteria enabled after the fix.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The project phase-boundary prompt is discoverable by local `rebar review-code`; verified by the preview command reaching the reviewer without an unknown-prompt error.
- [ ] Existing built-in and project prompt discovery tests pass.
data.title: Local code review rejects project phase-boundary prompt
